outputs.explanation: Panel A consists solely of micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker Deep Red, Merge) showing representative images; there is no bar/summary plot requiring individual data points.

Panel B includes micrographs plus two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity) showing group means with error bars (n=20 stated) but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a western blot image only, with no plotted averages requiring individual data points.

Panel D includes micrographs plus two bar charts (SDH and COX signal intensity) showing group means with error bars and sample sizes (N) indicated, but no individual data points are shown overlaid on the bars.

Panel E shows FACS histograms (cell counts vs. TMRM intensity) which are distribution/line-type plots displaying the full population data directly; this plot type is exempt from requiring separate individual data point overlays.
